info.name: Rodha Promocodes (FE)
info.description: Rodha-owned promocodes: create, bulk, update, batches, export (admin) and apply-by-code (student). Send only the fields you have; omitted = no condition (create) / unchanged (update). Dates YYYY-MM-DD (IST, inclusive). discountType PERCENT|FLAT. No packageIds/courseIds = applies to all products.

request.description:
code optional: omit to auto-generate (or send prefix).

### Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | no | 3–40 chars: A–Z 0–9 - _ (upper-cased). Omit to auto-generate. Duplicate (any case, incl. Graphy) → 409. |
| `prefix` | string | no | 1–20 chars. Only when code is omitted → `PREFIX-XXXXXXXX`. |
| `websiteCategoryId` | number | no | Website category (CAT, IPMAT, …). Omitted on create = 1. The code only works on products of this category; packageIds/courseIds must belong to it. |
| `discountType` | `PERCENT` \| `FLAT` | yes |  |
| `discountValue` | number > 0 | yes | PERCENT: max 100. FLAT: rupees. |
| `maxDiscountValue` | number ≥ 0 | no | Cap in ₹ for PERCENT. 0 / omitted = no cap. Ignored for FLAT. |
| `minCartValue` | number ≥ 0 | no | Item price must be at least this. |
| `validFrom` | `YYYY-MM-DD` \| null | no | IST, inclusive. Omitted = no start limit. |
| `validTill` | `YYYY-MM-DD` \| null | no | IST, inclusive. Must be ≥ validFrom. |
| `description` | string ≤ 2000 \| null | no |  |
| `isActive` | boolean | no | Default true. |
| `forNewUser` | boolean | no | Only students with no previous enrollment. |
| `isRepeater` | boolean | no | Label only (shown in admin). |
| `packageIds` | number[] (≤ 1000) | no | Products the code works on. packageIds and courseIds both empty = all products. |
| `courseIds` | number[] (≤ 1000) | no | As above, for courses. |
| `userIds` | uuid[] (≤ 1000) | no | Only these students (special students). |
| `conditionPackageIds` | number[] (≤ 1000) | no | Only students already enrolled in one of these packages (repeaters). userIds OR conditionPackageIds is enough. |
| `maxUseCount` | integer ≥ 0 | no | Total uses across all students. 0 / omitted = unlimited. |
| `autoApply` | boolean | no | Default true. false = listed for the student but never auto-applied. |

### Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer 1–5000 | yes | How many codes. |
| `prefix` | string 1–20 | no | Codes look like `PREFIX-XXXXXXXX`. |
| `websiteCategoryId` | number | no | Website category (CAT, IPMAT, …). Omitted on create = 1. The code only works on products of this category; packageIds/courseIds must belong to it. |
| `discountType` | `PERCENT` \| `FLAT` | yes |  |
| `discountValue` | number > 0 | yes | PERCENT: max 100. FLAT: rupees. |
| `maxDiscountValue` | number ≥ 0 | no | Cap in ₹ for PERCENT. 0 / omitted = no cap. Ignored for FLAT. |
| `minCartValue` | number ≥ 0 | no | Item price must be at least this. |
| `validFrom` | `YYYY-MM-DD` \| null | no | IST, inclusive. Omitted = no start limit. |
| `validTill` | `YYYY-MM-DD` \| null | no | IST, inclusive. Must be ≥ validFrom. |
| `description` | string ≤ 2000 \| null | no |  |
| `isActive` | boolean | no | Default true. |
| `forNewUser` | boolean | no | Only students with no previous enrollment. |
| `isRepeater` | boolean | no | Label only (shown in admin). |
| `packageIds` | number[] (≤ 1000) | no | Products the code works on. packageIds and courseIds both empty = all products. |
| `courseIds` | number[] (≤ 1000) | no | As above, for courses. |
| `userIds` | uuid[] (≤ 1000) | no | Only these students (special students). |
| `conditionPackageIds` | number[] (≤ 1000) | no | Only students already enrolled in one of these packages (repeaters). userIds OR conditionPackageIds is enough. |

Bulk codes are always single-use, never auto-applied and never listed; `code`, `maxUseCount`, `autoApply` are ignored.
